audit.whatIsWrong: Both chart layers disagreed with the packet and with the whys[] prose: level 1 was given to Gangplank while whys[0] says Yorick, level 6 to Gangplank while whys[4] says Yorick, and two-plus items to Yorick while whys[6] hands it to Gangplank's crit barrels and global R.
audit.why: phases[N].side and win[N] are the same row; every row was already explained correctly in prose and only the tokens were wrong.
audit.corrected: Chart set to the packet: Yorick, Yorick, Skill, Skill, Yorick, Yorick, Gangplank, proposed as matched full/content pairs with ratings rescaled to match. The mirror reports it made the same move.

audit.why: Spikes already run levels 3-5, level 6 Maiden, first item, and Gangplank's late crit-barrel takeover, which is the real shape of this lane.
audit.corrected: Kept; Cannon Barrage's true damage added to the late spike so the scaling row says why resistances do not save you.

audit.whatIsWrong: The text calls Remove Scurvy a 'citrus heal' but never says it cures crowd control, so it never tells you that it wipes Mourning Mist's slow off him.
audit.why: Remove Scurvy cures CC and restores health on 22/20/18/16/14 — it is both the cleanse against your E slow and the reason chip trades fail.
audit.corrected: Stated the cleanse, the 22s rank-1 cooldown as the commit window, and Grievous Wounds as the buy before any extended trade.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing in the itemization or trading text mentioned anti-heal timing.
audit.why: Remove Scurvy plus barrel poke means an untimed all-in loses to the heal.
audit.corrected: Grievous Wounds written into breakdown.mid and the content mid paragraph.

edits.before: Trade strictly around Powder Kegs: when it is down, run your full pattern; when it is up, give nothing. If behind, farm safe and let your spikes re-open the lane.
edits.after: Trade around his barrels: with none placed, run the full pattern. Remove Scurvy cures your E slow and heals him every 22s at rank 1, so buy Grievous Wounds before you commit.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Each safe minute is barrel mastery and crit gold — force the lane.

edits.before: At 3-6 keep the pressure on: W Dark Procession caging him off his barrel chains, E-slow to break his barrel spacing, and all-in with ghouls and Maiden rather than trading poke — never sit in a citrus-heal poke war you lose. His barrels get scarier each level, so force fights while your ghoul all-in still out-damages his combo. Deny his farm and deny his heal; a poke war is exactly what he wants.
edits.after: At 3-6 keep the pressure on: W Dark Procession caging him off his barrel chains, E-slow to break his barrel spacing, and all-in with ghouls and Maiden rather than trading poke. Remove Scurvy cures that slow and heals him on a 22s cooldown at rank 1 — bait it, commit inside those 22 seconds, and carry Grievous Wounds into every extended trade. Force fights while your ghoul all-in still out-damages his combo.

edits.before: Once GP has Trinity + Sheen crits and full barrel mastery his Q one-shots minions and pokes you out, and his R global plus barrel combos out-scale and out-teamfight your split.
edits.after: Once GP has Trinity + Sheen crits and full barrel mastery his Q one-shots minions and pokes you out, and Cannon Barrage's true damage ignores any armour or MR you stack against him.

edits.before: Q Parrrley + citrus poke and sustain
edits.after: Remove Scurvy to cleanse your E slow
